listing.name: Shadow of the Colossus — Celosia (HenryKun55)
listing.summary: This independent USA port uses different original files from LightVelox’s PAL port. Check this project’s status guide for current gameplay limits. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SCUS-97472 ISO and XFF modules.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s local extraction, recompilation and build scripts. A Vita build target alone does not establish a working Vita player.

warnings: This independent USA port uses different original files from LightVelox’s PAL port. Check this project’s status guide for current gameplay limits.
